_: The tone curve ladder. Each case is one curve, put into the shader by src/tone.js and chosen
from the address bar; the control is `khronos`, which is the library's own numbers and is what
the Villa ran before src/tone.js existed. Read the columns stats.js prints: `>230` and
`ceiling` say how much of the frame is pressed against the top of the picture, `lit ... sNN`
is the channel spread the sunlit band keeps, and `cNN%` is how much of the frame is in colour.
The picks follow one surface across all six curves.
knee, white and desat are the three knobs src/tone.js puts into the shader: where the bend
starts, what the very brightest light is worth on the screen, and how much white is mixed into
a colour that had to be folded a long way.
